entries.reason: Render-time carryover materialization writes background daily files and is not initiated by a user gesture.
Render-time sticky-note migration performs an idempotent background frontmatter heal outside any user gesture.
Kanban vault-event and startup reconciliation writes card projections automatically rather than from a user gesture.
The workstream picker delegates its structural transaction to RenderSafe.mutateStructure, whose write callback is outside this lint's RenderSafe.mutate authority.
New-person creation delegates its receipt-bound structural transaction to RenderSafe.mutateStructure, whose create callback is outside this lint's RenderSafe.mutate authority.
Bulk document relocation is a structural rename transaction whose target is not the active source note; its frontmatter rewrite is part of that transaction.
Single-document relocation is a structural rename transaction whose post-rename frontmatter rewrite must remain adjacent to the rename.
